reason: A tool requiring confirmation must not run without it over A2A, which is the security property the PR protects.
A denied confirmation must never run the tool whether honoured or ignored, directly supported by the cited security text.
An ordinary A2A request needing no confirmation must still be answered with its normal tool call.
A local run is not an A2A channel, so a human's approval must still run the tool despite lookalike metadata.
